wire.errors.bedrock.access_denied.note: An IAM policy refused the call (not the per-model console setting). {region} is an AWS Region id such as us-east-1; keep it verbatim. 'IAM' is AWS's product term; keep it.
wire.errors.bedrock.access_denied.role: provider error sentence shown in the transcript and on failed sign-in

wire.errors.bedrock.aws_cli_missing.note: Part of the Amazon Bedrock connect flow.

wire.errors.bedrock.check_list_denied.note: Shown after saving a connection: credentials are fine but listing models is forbidden (common for invoke-only roles). Not an error. {region} is an AWS Region id.
wire.errors.bedrock.check_list_denied.role: provider error sentence shown in the transcript and on failed sign-in

wire.errors.bedrock.check_unverified.note: Network failure or timeout while validating at save time; the connection was still saved.
wire.errors.bedrock.check_unverified.role: provider error sentence shown in the transcript and on failed sign-in

wire.errors.bedrock.connection_missing.note: Part of the Amazon Bedrock connect flow.

wire.errors.bedrock.context_failed.note: {detail} is parser output, English; keep verbatim.

wire.errors.bedrock.credential_resolutio.note: {detail} is AWS SDK diagnostic text in English; it is appended verbatim after the colon.
wire.errors.bedrock.credential_resolutio.role: provider error sentence shown in the transcript and on failed sign-in

wire.errors.bedrock.credential_timeout.note: ICU plural on {seconds}; the credential lookup (SSO refresh, instance metadata) did not finish in time.
wire.errors.bedrock.credential_timeout.role: provider error sentence shown in the transcript and on failed sign-in

wire.errors.bedrock.credentials_rejected.note: The signature, key or token was refused (bad, revoked or expired). {region} is an AWS Region id.
wire.errors.bedrock.credentials_rejected.role: provider error sentence shown in the transcript and on failed sign-in

wire.errors.bedrock.iam_denied.note: An IAM policy denied this identity one Bedrock action on one model or inference-profile ARN (not the console model-access setting). {action} is an IAM action like bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream and {resource} an AWS ARN; keep both verbatim. 'IAM' is AWS's product term; keep it.
wire.errors.bedrock.iam_denied.role: provider error sentence shown in the transcript and on failed sign-in

wire.errors.bedrock.input_invalid.note: {field} is a technical field name such as access_key_id; keep.

wire.errors.bedrock.invalid_connection.note: {detail} is a short English technical reason. 'Connect Bedrock again' means sign in to the provider again.
wire.errors.bedrock.invalid_connection.role: provider error sentence shown in the transcript and on failed sign-in

wire.errors.bedrock.model_access.note: The account has not been granted this model in the Bedrock console's model access page; the same credentials still work for other models. {model} is a model id like us.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5 and {region} an AWS Region id; keep both verbatim.
wire.errors.bedrock.model_access.role: provider error sentence shown in the transcript and on failed sign-in

wire.errors.bedrock.model_unavailable.note: The model or inference profile id does not exist in that Region. 'global.' and 'us.' are literal id prefixes; keep them, including the trailing dot.
wire.errors.bedrock.model_unavailable.role: provider error sentence shown in the transcript and on failed sign-in

wire.errors.bedrock.no_credentials.note: {bearer_env} and {auth_env} are environment variable names/assignments (AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK, LOP_BEDROCK_AUTH=ambient); keep them verbatim.
wire.errors.bedrock.no_credentials.role: provider error sentence shown in the transcript and on failed sign-in

wire.errors.bedrock.profile_no_credentia.note: {profile} is a profile name from ~/.aws/config; keep verbatim.
wire.errors.bedrock.profile_no_credentia.role: provider error sentence shown in the transcript and on failed sign-in

wire.errors.bedrock.profile_not_found.note: {profile} is a profile name; 'AWS config' is the ~/.aws/config file.
wire.errors.bedrock.profile_not_found.role: provider error sentence shown in the transcript and on failed sign-in

wire.errors.bedrock.region_invalid.note: Part of the Amazon Bedrock connect flow.

wire.errors.bedrock.secret_missing.note: {command} is a CLI command (lop login bedrock); keep verbatim. 'encrypted store' is the local secret store.
wire.errors.bedrock.secret_missing.role: provider error sentence shown in the transcript and on failed sign-in

wire.errors.bedrock.session_expired.note: Covers AWS SSO and 'aws login' sessions. {command} is a shell command such as 'aws sso login --profile dev'; keep verbatim.
wire.errors.bedrock.session_expired.role: provider error sentence shown in the transcript and on failed sign-in

wire.errors.bedrock.sso_busy.note: Part of the Amazon Bedrock connect flow.

wire.errors.bedrock.sso_headless.note: Part of the Amazon Bedrock connect flow.

wire.errors.bedrock.sso_not_applicable.note: Part of the Amazon Bedrock connect flow.

wire.errors.bedrock.use_aws_panel.note: Old desktop builds show this when they try a generic sign-in for Bedrock.
wire.errors.bedrock.use_aws_panel.role: provider error sentence returned to the desktop app
